a11y.coloursHelp: Everything color-coded — splits ahead or behind, warnings, checkpoint gates, the route, tire grip, the map — in colors that read apart, always with a sign, shape or word as well.
a11y.visualSoundsHelp: Tire grip shown on a car outline, engine damage and overheating warnings in words, arrows to cars close by, and crashes and gear grinds written under the speed.
aids.steering.help: Keyboard and gamepad: full lock only turns as far as the tires can use
damage.help: Full: dents, broken glass and lights, parts lose condition, and the mechanicals take damage (bent steering and suspension, punctures, a leaking radiator, a grinding transmission; a huge hit can tear a wheel off). Visual only: the dents and breakages, none of the mechanical effects. Off: none (the crash sounds stay).
onboard.tutorial.text: Five minutes on a real road: throttle and braking, cornering, the racing line, and what the tires and sounds tell you. Then we'll suggest the driving aids that suit you.
school.lesson.threshold-braking.lesson: A locked tire slides and can't steer: the shortest stop is just short of locking — listen for the squeal and hold it there.
school.lesson.trail-braking.lesson: Easing off the brake while turning keeps weight on the front tires, so the car turns in sharply.
school.lesson.wet-control.lesson: In the wet the tires have far less grip: every input has to be smoother.
tutorial.tyres.text: Push a little harder in a bend until the tires start to squeal: that's the edge of their grip. Ease off as it gets louder. (With "Show important sounds" on, the tire outline fills up the same way.)
tutorial.tyres.title: Listen to the tires
